{{Quote|The eight-base measure was developed by the Sumrias of the Lol system; members of the Sumrian thought-caste have four digits on each hand.|An Imperial document included in a report by Major Arhul Hextrophon|<ref name="IS2" />}}
The '''Lol system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Lol sector/Legends|Lol sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sumria]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Since members of the Sumrian [[thought-caste]] had four-fingered [[Limb/Legends|hands]], the species developed a base-eight measuring system that served as the basis for the development of [[Df]], a parameter characterizing the combat performance of military [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]].<ref name="IS2" />

Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Lol [[Star system/Legends|system]] was mentioned by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Arhul Hextrophon/Legends|Arhul Hextrophon]] in a compilation of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] documents for Alliance [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and other Rebel [[Officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="IS2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lol system was introduced in the ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'', a [[1989]] supplement written by [[Greg Gorden]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square Q-18.<ref name="TEA" />
